title: Network diagram
description: Layers of nodes joined by hairlines, drawn left to right; then a wave of gold signals travels from the first layer to the last. For a neural network, a pipeline of models, or any layered system.

props.layers: required, 2-5 of {label, nodes}: nodes is a number (2-6) or a list of short names like ["x1", "x2"]
